messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "Part of this shell"
set: ["Part of this shell", "part of this shell may appear in your stool", "is only part of complete treatment program", "talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry", "list of ingredients in this medicine", "this window", "this process", "this page", "this raises the risk of side effects", "this applies to most brands of levothyroxine", "do not wash or put any part of the inhaler device in water", "shell that is not absorbed or melted in the body", "this medication guide", "may be only part of a complete program of treatment that also includes changes in diet or lifestyle habits", "this is not a complete list of side effects", "keep this and all other medicines out of the reach of children"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
